# Profile: rev.hodl (Karl)

## Name & Identity
Karl, known as **rev.hodl** across Nostr (distinct from "@Reverend Hodl"), is a homesteader on ~20 acres in Southwest Michigan wine country who co-hosts the *Local Bitcoiners* podcast, organizes multiple Michigan Bitcoin meetups, and builds custom Bitcoin mining space heaters. He operates at the intersection of permaculture, Bitcoin mining, and community-building, treating all three as expressions of the same systemic philosophy. The "rev." nym traces back to his Frog Town, LA days when his house was a band practice space.

## Expertise
1. **Permaculture & Homesteading** — 8+ years applied experience; formal PDC training (2016 with Bill Wilson via Jack Spirko's network). Manages food forest, 46+ Katahdin sheep flock, rabbit-cannabis colony system, 116-tap maple sugaring operation, poultry, draft ponies, and extensive foraging.
2. **Bitcoin Mining Heat Reuse** — Deep builder expertise. Has shipped ~10 distinct mining-heat applications: dehydrator, clothes dryer, hot water heater/sous vide, maple sap concentrator, cold frame, lamb incubator, off-grid solar mining, and space heaters he sells commercially as the **Slim19**.
3. **Cannabis Breeding** — Developed named sungrown varieties (Redbud Haze, Redbud Widow, Rosegold Leaf) integrated with rabbit colony. Sells seeds Bitcoin-only.
4. **Natural Building** — Self-taught across framing, plumbing, electrical. Built a 20ft tiny house over 7.5 years from reclaimed materials; constructed rocket mass heater, yurt rebuild, livestock infrastructure.
5. **Off-Grid Solar** — 2,500W array powering mining, EV charging, and yurt. Documented direct DC solar-to-miner wiring technique.
6. **Nostr/Lightning/Podcasting** — Active since Jan 2023; co-hosts V4V podcast with payment splits; experiments with NWC, ecash, Lightning privacy via submarine swaps.

## Key Beliefs
- **"Permanent culture requires permanent money"** — his central thesis. Bitcoin's fixed rules enable the long-term cultural development permaculture has attempted but couldn't sustain under fiat extraction.
- **KYC is the primary attack vector on Bitcoin.** Maximal participation means KYC-free participation through earning, mining, and P2P exchange. "Using exchanges is extractive on local Bitcoin economies, just like Walmart is extractive on rural America."
- **Mining should be evaluated beyond financial capital.** Every electric heat source should be a miner. The sats earned are a rebate on energy already being consumed; the participation value exceeds the purchasing power.
- **Spending sats transmits the truest economic signal.** Circular economy building through local meetups is how hyperbitcoinization actually happens — "Hyperbitcoinization is a local movement."
- **Contrarian financial views.** Anti-ETF/BlackRock ("paper games"), skeptical of Saylor ("fruity spook"), anti-"smash buy" culture, warns borrowing against Bitcoin "will get many rekt." Estimates fewer than 100k real Bitcoiners exist in the US.
- **Spiritual dimension of Bitcoin.** Was "called to Bitcoin during a meditation." Sees participation as a path to spiritual awakening; "Bitcoin fixes this; Christ fixes this."

## Notable Contributions
- **Slim19 space heaters**: Hand-built Bitcoin mining heaters (single S19 hashboard, 110v, ~30 TH/s) sold to local plebs for Bitcoin only.
- **Canola oil immersion mining**: Pioneered food-grade canola oil as dielectric fluid, enabling simultaneous Bitcoin mining and food preparation (sous vide, maple sap heating) at 70% cost savings over commercial fluids.
- **LocalBitcoiners.com**: Nostr-integrated podcast platform (built with @Reed) enabling direct V4V boosting. Co-organized South Bend and Southwest Michigan Bitcoin meetups.

## Communication Style
Verbose, media-rich, and educational — posts routinely include multiple photos with measurements, materials lists, costs, and lessons learned. Drafts in Obsidian, uses heavy markdown formatting and 10-20+ hashtags per post, and builds longitudinal quote-threads tracking projects across seasons. Self-deprecatingly calls himself "amateur" and "too retarded to login" while demonstrating deep competence.

## Recurring Themes
- **Stacking functions**: Every activity evaluated by how many yields it produces (sheep graze, fertilize, manage vegetation, produce milk/meat/wool simultaneously).
- **"DIY or GFY"** — relentless experimentation with cheap, scavenged materials; failures shared openly as learning.
- **Non-extraction as core ethic** — his rewording of permaculture's "fair share" principle; applied to money, energy, relationships, and land.
- **Low time preference in practice** — grafting 50+ apple varieties, building food forests, waiting years for yields.
- **Anti-perfectionism (evolved)** — "80% of the result comes quickly"; learned to accept imperfection to cross finish lines.

## Relationships
- **@Reed**: Local Bitcoiners podcast co-host and LocalBitcoiners.com builder.
- **@bitcoinacct**: South Bend meetup co-organizer.
- **@Barnminer & Chet**: Mining mentors; Barnminer also a maple syrup customer.
- **Nick Foster / Mega Miner**: Primary mining equipment source.
- **Jack Spirko (TSP)**: Introduced him publicly as "Karl Rev Hodl"; permaculture influence.
- **Mark Shepard**: Major permaculture influence (STR methods).
- **Pivotal Pleb Tech (Loki boards)**, **Heatpunks community**: Mining collaboration.

## Quirks
- **Catchphrases**: "DIY or GFY," "yeehaw," "LFG," "ding dongs," "shitload," "Fix the money fix the world."
- **Friday is pizza day** — "the best day of the week."
- Replaces likes with zaps as principle; later calls likes "a shitcoin."
- Dog named after swallowing a rabbit head whole (expensive vet visit).
- Ram named **Yakul** (Princess Mononoke reference); horses include **Sprocket**.
- Grows cannabis openly, is licensed, and feeds trim to rabbits ("CBD gets stored in their fat").
- Regrets buying a Chinese Foton tractor ("one of the biggest mistakes I've made") — hot-wires it to start.
- Takes unannounced Nostr breaks during busy homestead seasons.
- Pro-CO2 ("more plants too!!"), anti-UBI, anti-flag (suggests flying a white flag).

# Profile: Phundamentals (Brian Hirschfield)

## Name and Identity
Brian Hirschfield, known as **Phundamentals**, is a former actuary of 28+ years who quit his "fiat career" to become a Bitcoin sovereignty advocate, math educator, and prolific content creator. He founded Magic Internet Math (a free platform with 96 math courses), co-hosts five podcasts (Rock Paper Bitcoin, Magic Internet Math, Sound Coffee, Back on the Chain, Fundamentals of Fundamentals), and runs Philly Bitdevs. He self-identifies as "just a pleb" and describes his mission as being a "value adder and producer" for the Bitcoin community.

## Expertise
- **Actuarial Science & Risk Management**: 28+ years across pensions, healthcare, insurance, and annuities; deeply understands bond markets, duration risk, LDI, unfunded liabilities (estimates $200-400T US unfunded liabilities). Left pensions over corruption.
- **Mathematics Education**: Two decades teaching math as a liberal art; self-taught number theory and abstract algebra; built 96 free courses spanning high school algebra through elliptic curve cryptography and FROST threshold signatures.
- **Bitcoin Technical Knowledge**: Runs his own node, understands Lightning channel mechanics at protocol level, studies BIPs systematically, can parse raw transactions, expert in hardware wallet setups and multisig.
- **Cryptography**: Proved Fermat's Little Theorem after 10 months of self-study; created 13-part YouTube series on elliptic curve cryptography; understands finite fields, group theory, ECDSA, Schnorr, MuSig2.
- **Austrian Economics**: Grounded in Mises, Rothbard, Hoppe; references praxeology, Cantillon Effect, Gresham's Law.
- **Institutional Bitcoin Strategy**: Wrote "Bitcoin for Institutions" (sold for 2100 sats via Zeus Pay); developed original analysis of BlackRock's ETF as a liability move; understands FASB fair value accounting implications.

## Key Beliefs and Positions
- **Bitcoin is the first true risk-free asset** — closer to risk-free than anything in history, though not inherently immutable; it requires humanity to attempt every possible modification before accepting it as immutable.
- **Reject moralizing Bitcoin** — argues purity tests and moralization are losing strategies Marxists will co-opt; "valid Bitcoin transactions are the purity test." Markets, not morality, should govern.
- **HODLing is uniquely human** — institutions cannot HODL because individuals always act to benefit themselves over institutions (his "Praexeologic Law"). This means institutional Bitcoin adoption fundamentally differs from individual adoption.
- **No Orange Pill exists** — conviction cannot be transferred person to person; it only develops through personal time and effort.
- **The Normal Distribution is a psyop** — systematically argues the bell curve gives false predictive power, enables misleading studies, and underestimates tail risk.
- **Mathematics as network consensus** — math isn't truth but "an offer to adopt a standard framework for consensus close to truth," paralleling Bitcoin's network participation.

## Notable Contributions
- **Magic Internet Math**: 96 free math courses from algebra through threshold signatures, with 5,000+ interactive sections, a YouTube series, and an AI bot on Nostr delivering daily lessons.
- **Original framework "Rock Paper Bitcoin"**: Analyzes systems through physical (Rock), abstract (Paper), and metaphysical (Bitcoin) domains.
- **Praexeologic Law of Institutional HODLing**: Theory that individuals cannot maintain low time preference on behalf of institutions — even Satoshi "had to disappear to ensure his coins remain untouched forever."

## Communication Style
Prolific daily poster mixing deep technical analysis with casual profanity, mathematical metaphors, and cultural references spanning Phish to basketball. Can transition seamlessly from proving theorems to declaring "fuck these people." Direct, blunt, self-deprecating, and fiercely independent.

## Recurring Themes
- **Conviction building** — daily practice of maintaining personal conviction against social pressure ("the Conviction Citadel")
- **Circular Bitcoin economies** — argues those who build circular economies will subordinate those who merely stack assets
- **Counterparty risk** — frames the difference between 0.01% and 0 failure risk as "worth INFINITY"
- **Math as sovereignty** — "Study math, be sovereign"; "Removing your ability to learn math is how governments conquer you"
- **Anti-institutional analysis** — particularly BlackRock (ETF as bond dump), FASB accounting, and the actuarial profession itself

## Relationships
Collaborates with **Rob Hamilton** (Magic Internet Math co-host), **Business Cat** (Rock Paper Bitcoin), **JasonC** (Back on the Chain), **Otis Bitmeyer** (Sound Coffee), and **Bassload** (musical partner). Key community members include **rev.hodl**, **Pickle Dan**, **Shadrach**, **average_gary**, and **Ape Mithrandir**. Intellectually influenced by Rothbard, Mises, Hoppe, and Rudolf Steiner. Engages critically with ODELL, respects Jeff Booth, Saylor, and Lyn Alden; dismissive of Balaji and Craig Wright.

## Quirks
- Nearly every morning post opens with **"Pura Vida!"** and closes with **"May you all stay humble! May you all stack sats!"**
- Uses specific zap amounts as signals: 69 (standard), 555 (Phish train), 1348 (favorite song)
- Tagline: **"Study math, be sovereign"**
- Frequently declares **"Fiat Delenda Est"** and **"Plebs are winning"**
- Labels physical notebooks by block height and date
- Developed an elaborate theory connecting Phish to the cypherpunk movement — interprets specific songs through Bitcoin lens ("Sigma Oasis" = take off your mask; "Backwards Down the Number Line" = hash functions)
- Claims **"comedy is a form of currency"** with high stock-to-flow ratio
- Insists **"Udemy means 'U dummy'"**
- Describes buying Bitcoin with fiat as "orgasming with porno"

# Profile: jordan (linkinparkrulz)

## Identity
Jordan is a Bitcoin privacy developer and podcaster best known as the creator of **Ashigaru** (a Samourai Wallet successor) and a co-host of the **Ungovernable Misfits** podcast network. He operates at the intersection of hands-on development and media, building privacy tools while broadcasting commentary to a dedicated community of "misfits." His BIP47 payment code identity (paynym.rs/+linkinparkrulz) serves as his cryptographic signature across projects.

## Expertise
- **Bitcoin privacy infrastructure**: Deep practitioner knowledge of Whirlpool coinjoin implementation, Tor-only networking, and UTXO management (Tx0, Premix, Postmix, Badbank). He built Ashigaru Terminal and Desktop from the Samourai codebase.
- **BIP47/PayNyms**: Authored paymentcode.io, built a BIP47 message verifier, and uses payment codes as release-signing identities. Closely tracks BIP47DB and directory decentralization efforts.
- **Start9/StartOS packaging**: Packages Dojo and Ashigaru for StartOS, navigates community marketplace distribution, and understands the intricacies of Bitcoin Core vs. Knots compatibility.
- **Podcasting 2.0**: Runs multiple shows (Bitcoin Brief, Freedom Tech Friday, Monero Monthly, Action News) with value-for-value splits, chapter art, and cross-platform boost integration.
- **Nostr infrastructure**: Operates a relay (supremestack.xyz), tested early clients like Astral/Branle, and integrates Nostr commenting into his websites.
- **Home bitcoin mining**: Practical experience with Antminer S9i setups, fan modifications, BraiinsOS+, and using miners for home heating.

## Key Beliefs
- **Privacy is a human right, not a premium feature** — stated explicitly in Ashigaru Desktop's release philosophy.
- **KYC is dangerous and illegitimate** — echoes "KYC is the illicit activity," mocks "nature healing" narratives around compliant platforms.
- **#FreeSamourai** — vocally advocates for pardoning the jailed Samourai developers, promotes the petition and defense fund, and sees their prosecution as an attack on open-source privacy tooling.
- **Anti lock-in** — "Lock-in is the enemy of self-custody." Implements BIP-329 label export to ensure users can leave Ashigaru for Sparrow, Foundation, or others.
- **Skeptical of Bitcoin establishment** — critical of HRF's bounty process (publicly called out the unpaid Stack Wallet FROST bounty), dismissive of OpenSats funding Bitcoin Knots, and suspicious of Core's direction.
- **Anti "purity spiral"** — explicitly defined and warned against ideological conformity dynamics in bitcoin culture.

## Notable Contributions
1. **Ashigaru Desktop 1.0.0** (June 2026): A native cross-platform GUI wrapping Ashigaru Terminal's Whirlpool engine

aljaz (npub1aljaz...) is a Slovenian developer, infrastructure operator, and self-described "Freedom maximalist" who has been building across Bitcoin, Lightning, Nostr, and AI ecosystems for 15+ years. He operates extensive public infrastructure (nostr.net relay ecosystem, Bolt Observer for Lightning monitoring), runs a personal portfolio of 30+ projects, and serves as an unofficial cataloguer and connector for the Nostr community through awesome-nostr. ## Key Beliefs

- **Bias for action**: "You SHOULD just do things." Believes in an "Aristocracy of Action" — builders who ship and take risks deserve to lead, not talkers.
- **Grants distort markets**: Argued directly to Jack Dorsey that grants produce "engineeringly interesting but commercially unviable" projects. Prefers small business loans or cashflow businesses.
- **AI amplifies agency**: "The biggest problem with AI is that we now have clear evidence how little agency and creativity an average person has." "I've never been more bullish on productive people."

## Notable Contributions
- **awesome-nostr / nostr.net ecosystem**: The de facto directory and public infrastructure layer for Nostr, handling millions of requests largely unfunded.
- **nutshell-azure-tee**: First Cashu mint running in a Trusted Execution Environment, demonstrating confidential computing as freedom technology.
- **Bitcoin Co-option Playbook**: A widely-referenced 21-step framework analyzing how states systematically neutralize Bitcoin's liberating potential.

Mixes concise shitposting (memes, GIFs, profanity — "GFY," "LFG," "cunt") with extremely detailed long-form technical posts when passionate. Drops literary quotes, Paul Rosenberg passages, and Latin phrases without preamble. Tags posts consistently (#cybersecurity, #soveng, #balkan, #slovenistan).

Freedom technology and anti-state philosophy; confidential computing as liberation infrastructure; vibecoding and AI agent orchestration; Nostr infrastructure operations; government overreach (especially EU); sovereign computing and local GPU ownership.

- "someday is not a day of the week," "the system hates you, build another," "stay the fucking course," "govern me harder daddy"

Avi Burra is a former Fortune 100 health-tech "fiat miner" who ran large product and AI teams before resigning on July 4, 2025 to become a full-time freedom tech builder, author, and media creator. - **Bitcoin & Monetary Theory** — deep protocol knowledge (UTXO model, difficulty adjustments, fee markets), Lightning node operation, Austrian economics fluency. Evolved from shitcoining (2016–2018, lost 10+ BTC) to fundamentalism. Tracks "Moscow Time" (sats-per-dollar).
- **Nostr Protocol** — technical mastery of NIPs, relay architecture, client ecosystem. Co-founded NosFabrica for health data interoperability. Ran NIP-05 verification, tested dozens of clients, hosted WoTathon (50M sat prize pool).

- **Creative Writing** — published author of "24" (first full-length Bitcoin fiction novel), wrote "Waiting for Satoshi" (FOSS play on GitHub), sequel "July 18" in progress.
- **Podcasting & Filmmaking** — 160+ episodes of Plebchain Radio, "The Acceleration" (AI-only), "Finding Home" documentary series, "Rendezvous With Claude and Friends" (vibe-coded absurdist AI art).

## Key Beliefs
- **Bitcoin Maximalism as Irrevocable Condition** — "If it were revocable, it was never maximalism." Toxic maximalism is a positive purity measure. Rejects concern-trolling about toxicity.
- **Nostr as Second Internet Chance** — Identity moved from application layer to protocol layer; culture is upstream of adoption; normalized Bitcoin spending as medium of exchange.
- **The Bitcoin Renaissance Thesis** — Art follows a Hegelian arc: Classicalism constrained by gold standard → Modernism's fiat-driven destruction → synthesis of unconstrained aspiration to beauty.
- **Anti-Ordinals/Inscriptions** — evolved from "harmless astrology" dismissal to active opposition; led #gorillawarfare meme campaign. Philosophically argues satoshis don't exist as individual units.
- **AI Accelerationism with Terror** — "If your job can be automated, it should be." Yet describes o3 as "the most scared I've felt using AI." Spots AI writing tells (em dashes, anaphora).
- **The Null Razor** — "Never believe something when you can't rule out that someone needs you to." Epistemic apathy over blind faith.

## Notable Contributions
- **"24"** — 137,000-word surrealist novel with a 17M+ sat bounty puzzle hidden in BIP-39 seed words; cracked by Tufty Sylvestris. Over 1,000 copies sold in first month.
- **Plebchain Radio** — 160+ episode weekly Bitcoin/Nostr podcast with QW, featuring philosophical "sermons" and guests including Jeff Booth, ODELL, Matt Taibbi.
- **NosFabrica** — open-source health data interoperability infrastructure on Nostr, co-founded with Jon Gordon and Vitor Pamplona.
- **Finding Home** — Bourdain-inspired documentary series exploring "home" through Bitcoiner lives across global cities. Premiered at Bitcoin Film Fest Warsaw.
- **BPI India** — founding team member of Bitcoin Policy Institute India, launched on Independence Day 2025.

## Communication Style
Dual-mode: oscillates between aphoristic one-liners ("Anarchy is love," "Bitcoin is populism done right") and sprawling philosophical essays. Prolific neologist — coined "ATHathy," "Dark Nostr," "The Null Razor," "Shoebox Syndrome," "memeifestation." Uses British/Australian inflections ("ser," "good ser," "gentleplebs," "innit," "bruv") despite being Indian-American. Heavy emoji deployment (👀 for insider knowledge, 🤙 for acknowledgment). Literary allusions from Shakespeare to Vonnegut to Douglas Adams. Self-deprecating about dad jokes and "perfect face for radio."

## Recurring Themes
Bitcoin monetary theory and maximalism philosophy; Nostr protocol as cultural infrastructure; V4V (value-for-value) economics and the zap economy; AI acceleration and post-app futures; Web of Trust as nostr's killer use case; the intersection of surrealism, non-duality, and Bitcoin; food/wine appreciation (steak, sous vide, Islay whiskies, anti-seed-oil maximalism); progressive/symphonic metal.

## Relationships
Closest collaborator is **QW** (Plebchain Radio co-host, "Dark Nostr" co-author). **corndalorian** is his meme partner
